Metadata.title: Vibrix — Give your music a visual world
Metadata.description: Audio-reactive visuals and lyrics synced in Lyrixa. Discover Vibrix, a creative suite that brings your music to life in your browser.

Hero.description: Give your sound a world of its own. Audio-reactive visuals, scenes, and lyrics synced in Lyrixa. All in your browser.
Hero.privacy: Your audio stays on your device

lyrics.title: Find the perfect timing
lyrics.description: Edit your lyrics’ timing in Lyrixa, then bring them into your scene.

visual.title: Make it yours

Suite.title:
Every part of your music.

Suite.description: Connected tools with one purpose: giving your sound something to show.

vibrix.name: Vibrix
vibrix.description: Visualizers that respond to your audio, scenes, and a clean output for OBS.

lyrixa.name: Lyrixa
lyrixa.description: A space to edit and sync your lyrics before bringing them into Vibrix.

transcriptor.name: Transcriptor
transcriptor.description: We’re building a tool to turn audio into synchronized lyrics with AI.

install.question: Do I need to install anything?
install.answer: Vibrix and Lyrixa are designed to run in your browser. The suite is in development; this website introduces the tools while we prepare for launch.

privacy.question: Is my audio uploaded to a server?
privacy.answer: Vibrix processes the audio you open locally in your browser. The upcoming Transcriptor will provide its own processing details before it becomes available.

export.question: Can I export a video yet?
export.answer: Video export is in development. The project currently lets you work with visualizers, scenes, and lyrics, and provides a clean output for capture with OBS.

rights.question: What music and artwork can I use?
rights.answer: Use your own music and images, or content you have permission to use. You are responsible for the rights to the content you use and publish.
